description:
AI meeting notetaker that records system audio without a bot joining your call.

MeetWave turns your meetings into notes, summaries and action items automatically.
Unlike other AI meeting tools, MeetWave does not send a bot to join your call — it
records system audio and microphone locally on your PC, transcribes the conversation
with Whisper and generates AI summaries with action items. Works with Zoom, Microsoft
Teams, Google Meet and any other meeting app. Recording is always user-initiated and
your data stays under your control.
